name: Nile
hint: The world's longest river, flowing northward through northeastern Africa to the Mediterranean Sea

name: Amazon
hint: The world's largest river by discharge, flowing through the vast rainforest of South America

name: Congo
hint: Africa's deepest river and the world's second largest by discharge, flowing in a great arc through central Africa

name: Danube
hint: Europe's second longest river, flowing eastward from the Black Forest through 10 countries to the Black Sea

name: Rhine
hint: A major European river flowing from the Swiss Alps northward to the North Sea, forming borders along the way

name: Mekong
hint: Southeast Asia's longest river, flowing from the Tibetan Plateau through six countries to the South China Sea

name: Zambezi
hint: Southern Africa's fourth longest river, famous for Victoria Falls on the Zambia-Zimbabwe border

name: Niger
hint: West Africa's principal river, making a distinctive inland arc through the Sahel before turning south to the Atlantic

name: Ganges
hint: The sacred river of the Indian subcontinent, rising in the Himalayas and flowing to the Bay of Bengal

name: Euphrates
hint: One of the cradles of civilization in the Middle East, flowing from Anatolia to the Persian Gulf

name: Tigris
hint: Ancient river flowing through Mesopotamia alongside the Euphrates, heartland of early civilizations

name: Indus
hint: One of the longest rivers in Asia, originating in Tibet and flowing to the Arabian Sea through the Indian subcontinent

name: Orange
hint: The longest river entirely in southern Africa, flowing westward from the Drakensberg to the Atlantic Ocean

name: Senegal
hint: West African river forming the natural border between Senegal and Mauritania before emptying into the Atlantic

name: Okavango
hint: A unique river that flows inland to form a vast delta in the Kalahari Desert instead of reaching the sea

name: Orinoco
hint: One of South America's longest rivers, forming much of the natural border between Venezuela and Colombia

name: Paraná
hint: South America's second largest river by discharge, flowing southward through three countries

name: Rio Grande
hint: Long river forming a natural border between the United States and Mexico before emptying into the Gulf of Mexico

name: Amur
hint: One of the world's longest rivers, forming most of the boundary between the Russian Far East and northeastern China

name: Irtysh
hint: Major river flowing from China's Xinjiang through Kazakhstan's steppes into the vast Siberian plains of Russia

name: Columbia
hint: Major river in the Pacific Northwest, originating in Canada's Rocky Mountains before flowing through the United States to the Pacific

name: Jordan
hint: Historic river in the Middle East flowing from Mount Hermon through the Sea of Galilee to the Dead Sea
